text:
gina: deploybot spotted a spike in post-deploy synthetic failures for the chat-route in apac2 after the 23:30 rollout. seems different from usual warmup noise. tagging eng-releases.

deploy-bot: AUTO: postdeploy-synth apac2 chat-route: 4/6 failures in 5m window. detected "route_mismatch" header on 2 failures. rolling forward paused. rollout cohort: 25%. logs: /deploy/logs/1762479011/apac2.

ops-bot: quick telemetry: client-side p99 404s spiked from 0 -> 0.9% concurrent with deploy. Trace suggests traffic to model-variant: quant-v1-beta on eu-legacy backend via edge-route fallback.

leo: interesting — routing to quant-v1-beta was supposed to be gated only for internal perf testing. how did traffic get routed to legacy backend?

pam: did the compile pipeline include a stale routing table? I pushed a small routing patch this morning. checking CI deploy annotations.

irene: can we pin the new rollout to the previous model (model-v3-stable) and re-run smoke tests quickly? If routing is misdirecting to quant variant we should block user traffic.

gina: consensus: pause rollout, pin to model-v3-stable globally for the chat-route, then triage routing config. If pinning fails, prepare emergency rollback.

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout paused by gina. Pinning chat-route -> model-v3-stable in progress.

(pam pastes a snippet)
pam: routing patch diff: 
```
- route.chat: prefer variant: quant-v1-beta
+ route.chat: prefer variant: model-v3-stable
```

pam: applying config to canary, then to all zones. will run synthetic generator against canary host after config push.

ops-bot: synthetic runner report (canary): 10/10 success, p95 72ms. No route_mismatch headers.

leo: great. rolling pin to 100% now. please watch for residual connections to eu-legacy.

deploy-bot: ACTION: route pin complete. canary cohort set to 100%.

irene: running a 3m soak with higher-frequency probes (5s interval) to ensure no bounce-back. also increasing circuit-breaker sensitivity to 2 failures in 30s for this check.

(90 seconds)

gina: small blip: 2 failures in apac2 still showing but logs indicate 504s from the edge-proxy, upstream returned empty response. looks like a separate proxy health issue.

ops-bot: checking edge-proxy fleet: one host in apac2 marked unhealthy, LB started sending to backup path which had a stale route table pointing at eu-legacy. that's the dangling link. marking host for reboot.

leo: if edge host reboot resolves it, we can avoid rollback. provisioning reboot now.

(2 minutes)

ops-bot: host reboot complete. synthetic runner back to 100% success. no route_mismatch headers. p95 65ms.

gina: decision: no rollback. Root cause: combination of stale route table on backup edge host + permissive variant preference that allowed quant-v1-beta. Short term mitigations: 1) pin chat-route to stable during change window (ops and releases) 2) add a pre-deploy check for route-table drift (eng-platform) 3) remove permissive auto-prefer for quant variants unless explicitly opted-in (product).

pam: will update release notes: "During rollout to apac2, a backup edge host with stale routing caused a minority of post-deploy synthetic failures. Pinned chat-route to model-v3-stable and rebooted affected host; rollout completed without user impact."

leo: follow-ups: file infra ticket to sweep edge hosts for stale route tables (infra#987). schedule a post-release QA window to validate routing table consistency next change window.

irene: logging note: capturing the trace IDs for the failed probes and attaching to infra ticket.

gina: closing thread after 30m of stable synths. thanks all. :rocket:
